name: motif_remove_feature_value
description:
Remove a feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if the affix or stem really takes every value of the feature; otherwise change the value by removing it and authoring the new one with compose-author-feature-value (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages the removal of one feature's specification from a stem's MsFeatures, an inflectional affix's InflFeats, or a derivational affix's FromMsFeatures or ToMsFeatures, so the stem stops carrying the feature or the affix stops requiring or giving it. The feature structure stays. Refuses a feature the structure does not specify. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-remove-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

feat_struc.description: Id of the feature structure on a stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix.

feature.description: Id of the feature whose specification is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
